title: Gender Bias in Large Language Models across Multiple Languages

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating disparity impact (DI) scores for descriptive word selection given gender-related contexts, measuring DI scores for pronoun (he/she) generation given specific descriptive words, and analyzing the distribution and sentiment of topics in LLM-generated dialogues across different gender pairings (e.g., female-female, male-male, female-male).
